parameters: \rWhere are you off to in such\na hurry?
\rIf you keep going this way, you'll eventually reach Berry Forest.
\rDid I just win?\nOr did I lose?
\rOh, no, don't come here!\nPlease, stay away from me!
\rI can't get out of the water!
\rMy mommy said that I can't swim without my float ring.
\rThis year, I'm going to finally learn how to swim!
\rJoy: I really want to battle with Meg.
\rJoy: We'll teach you what our favorite Pokémon is!
Set the partner event's Self Switch "A" on.
\rJoy: Wasn't that fun?\nI hope we can battle again!
\rThe salty tang of the sea...\nIt tickles my heart.
\rPerhaps that reek is your sweaty Pokémon's body odor...
\rMeg: I want to battle together with Joy.
\rMeg: We'll show you our favorite Pokémon.
Set the partner event's Self Switch "A" on.
